question: Does coordinate-consistent projected-heading-rate feedback improve the frozen known-pose E1 closed loop?
cause: OraclePathPolicy uses proprio world omega_z as measured yaw rate while yaw is atan2 of the world projection of the rotated body X axis. These differ under tilt. Archived E1 physics gives materially lower heading-difference residual with the analytic projected-axis derivative.
only_change: At a genuine current tracking request, replace the measured rate in the existing outer yaw auxiliary correction with the instantaneous derivative of atan2(e_y,e_x), e=R(q)*[1,0,0], de=world_omega cross e. Keep desired yaw rate, feedback gain, plus/minus5degree clip, BankMap, all main requests and inherited tracker state transitions unchanged.
distinction: Not body-course pure pursuit, not deleting yaw feedback, not gyro integration or pose estimator changes, not retraining closed execution memory.
inputs: Only the current PolicyObservation quaternion and world angular velocity; no future observations, state labels, solver query, imagery or learned predictions.
singular: Horizontal-axis norm squared <=1e-8 returns unsupported and inherits the original request. Invalid nonfinite/nonunit quaternion or angular velocity rejects. Quaternion horizontal heading must match observation yaw within1e-6 radians at qualified tracking requests.
interface: Tracker subclass wraps one inherited act with current-observation context cleared in finally; it adjusts the existing correction immediately before inherited BankMap request consumption. Nontracking requests unchanged. Preserve measured_world_yaw_rate_rad_s as physical omega_z, record projected heading rate separately, mark preconsumer model-proxy diagnostics as such.
implementation: heading_rate.py with projected_heading_rate(q,world_omega), with_heading_rate_tracker(base,enabled), and with_heading_rate_policy(base,enabled)
offline_budget: One archived sparse dense_current_live_e1_b0_run_v1 coordinate-consistency audit, no policy act replay/solver/CAD/prediction/teacher budgets from closed candidates.
physical_proposal: At most one same-driver known-pose TaskH E1 B0 and one candidate, 35s and350 requests each, no retries. Requires independent CPU/interface/identity/prelaunch review first; no physics admitted by this design file alone.
scope: Current and past known simulator pose/kinematics privileged diagnostic; fixed SGBM sparse source, risk memory and TaskH ground/start/unknown priors. No pureRGB/native/fullmatrix admission.
stop: No actual intervention => unassessed incremental effect. Runtime/integrity failures retain exact class. Valid intervention with failed navigation gates rejects this fixed candidate, no gain/clip/singularity scans.
